# Cleanse.ng · Professional House Cleaning in Ibadan

> Cleanse.ng is a managed residential cleaning service in Ibadan, Nigeria. Customers book online or on WhatsApp and deal with Cleanse directly, not with an individual cleaner. Each visit is carried out by one vetted, reference-checked, trained Cleanse Pro. IMPORTANT: Cleaning supplies and chemicals are NOT included for free in any package — customers provide their own cleaning products and tools, or add supplies for ₦2,000 per visit. Cleanse manages the service centrally (scheduling, messages before and after each visit, feedback, complaints, renewals and payment links) and remains responsible for the service from booking to completion.

Cleanse offers regular (routine) cleaning, deep cleaning, move-in/move-out cleaning, and post-fumigation cleaning for homes of 1–5 bedrooms. Pricing is flat and upfront by home size, with one-time visits or managed monthly plans (Once a week = 4 visits/month, or Twice a week = 8 visits/month). Service area: 6 primary zones in Ibadan, Oyo State — Bodija, Oluyole, Akobo, Iyaganku, Jericho, and GRA (Agodi / Phase 1 & 2), plus the University of Ibadan area.

## Key facts
- Business: Cleanse.ng (residential house cleaning service)
- Location: Ibadan, Oyo State, Nigeria
- Service model: fully managed by Cleanse; each visit is done by one vetted, trained Cleanse Pro; cleaning supplies are NOT included for free in any package (customers provide their own products and tools, or add supplies for ₦2,000 per visit); customers contact Cleanse on WhatsApp for anything about their visits
- Booking: online at https://cleanse.ng, or WhatsApp +234 913 066 3739
- Hours: 8am–6pm daily
- Pricing (per visit): 1BR ₦5,000 · 2BR ₦10,000 · 3BR ₦15,000 · 4BR ₦20,000 · 5BR ₦25,000. Monthly plans, billed monthly. Once a week (4 visits/month): 1BR ₦20,000 · 2BR ₦30,000 · 3BR ₦40,000 · 4BR ₦50,000 · 5BR ₦60,000; twice a week (8 visits/month): 1BR ₦30,000 · 2BR ₦40,000 · 3BR ₦60,000 · 4BR ₦70,000 · 5BR ₦80,000.
- Visit & payment rules: Monthly plans follow your selected schedule (Once a week or Twice a week). For the first month, payment is split 50% upfront before service starts and 50% later in the month; subsequent months are paid in full upfront. One-time visits are paid upfront before confirmation.

## Services
- [Cleaning Services in Ibadan (overview)](https://cleanse.ng/cleaning-services-ibadan): all services, areas, pricing and FAQ.
- Regular cleaning: routine upkeep to keep a home consistently maintained.
- [Deep cleaning in Ibadan](https://cleanse.ng/deep-cleaning-ibadan): intensive, top-to-bottom clean, from ₦15,000 (upfront quote by bedrooms, bathrooms and condition, on WhatsApp).
- [Move-in / move-out cleaning in Ibadan](https://cleanse.ng/move-in-move-out-cleaning-ibadan): detailed end-of-tenancy or move-ready clean, from ₦20,000 (upfront quote on WhatsApp).
- Post-fumigation cleaning: full reset after fumigation, priced by quote on WhatsApp.

## Areas served (6 zones in Ibadan)
- [Bodija](https://cleanse.ng/bodija-house-cleaning): Bodija Estate, Ashi, Sango, UI area.
- [Oluyole](https://cleanse.ng/oluyole-house-cleaning): Oluyole Estate, Ring Road, Liberty Road.
- [Akobo](https://cleanse.ng/akobo-house-cleaning): Ojurin, General Gas.
